name: Autogrill
verdict: Autogrill belongs to Avolta AG (formerly Dufry), a listed Swiss travel-retail group whose largest shareholder is Edizione S.p.A. Nothing found.
note: Official Partner of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to autogrill.it, stands under 'Official Partners' with the line 'Food and Beverage services for people on the move' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026). Rating note (2026-09-30): Autogrill belongs to Avolta AG (formerly Dufry AG), listed in Zurich (autogrill-avolta-ownership). Avolta's Corporate Governance Report 2025 (https://www.avoltaworld.com/system/files/2026-03/Corporate%20Governance.pdf) lists the holders of 3% or more at 31 December 2025: Edizione S.p.A. 22.17%, Advent International 8.72%, Helikon Investments 5.04%, Compagnie Financière Rupert 4.94%, the Qatar Investment Authority 4.49% (held by Qatar Holding LLC), BlackRock 3.93% and UBS Fund Management 3.60%. Qatar has a record in this data, but its stake is below 5% and the report's board biographies name no Qatar Investment Authority representative, so the link test isn't met. A notice that the stake is back at 5% or more would change this. No human-rights finding against the company found.
